name: Raya University
location: Maichew, also spelled Maychew, in southern Tigray
distanceNote: A long northern journey to southern Tigray.
campuses: One main campus in the Maichew area.
knownFor: Serving southern Tigray as an access point to higher education, offering an alternative to traveling further north to Mekelle
A cool, mixed highland climate with seasonal rains
Being one of the smaller, newer universities in the Tigray region
whatToExpect: As with the rest of the region, recent years have affected infrastructure and services to varying degrees, confirm current operating conditions directly with the university before making travel plans based on older information.
The distance and remoteness from Addis are real, most students plan around the main academic breaks rather than expecting frequent trips home.
Being smaller than Mekelle University, some students describe a more tightly knit, personal campus community here, though also fewer program options and facilities overall.
Cool nights and seasonal rains mean real warm layers and rain gear are both necessary at different points in the year.
tips: Confirm current campus operations and conditions directly with the university before traveling, given how much has shifted in the region recently.
Pack both warm layers and rain gear, the highland and mid altitude mix here brings both cold nights and real seasonal rain.
studentFit: Raya University suits students from southern Tigray who want a closer, smaller alternative to Mekelle, or anyone comfortable with a newer, more compact regional university. It fits people who value a tighter knit community over a wider range of program options. Students seeking the fuller facilities and broader academic catalogue of a larger, more established university like Mekelle should weigh that trade off carefully.
strengths: Serving southern Tigray as an access point to higher education, offering an alternative to traveling further north to Mekelle
A cool, mixed highland climate with seasonal rains
Being one of the smaller, newer universities in the Tigray region
